result.instructions: Tools for Recall.ai, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our meetings are being recorded right now?"; "Send a bot to the 10:00 client call and tell me when it has joined."; "Get the transcript of last week's sales call and summarize the decisions.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recall.ai data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run recallai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recallai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recallai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. recallai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recallai_list_bots
tools.title: List bots
tools.description: List meeting bots in the workspace with their status, meeting URL and schedule. Use it to find a bot id. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/bot/.

status.description: Filter by bot status code as the Recall.ai docs define it (for example done).

platform.description: Filter by meeting platform, for example zoom, google_meet or microsoft_teams.

meeting_url.description: Filter by the exact meeting URL.

join_at_after.description: Only bots scheduled to join at or after this ISO 8601 time.

join_at_before.description: Only bots scheduled to join before this ISO 8601 time.

tools.name: recallai_get_bot
tools.title: Get bot
tools.description: Get one meeting bot: its status changes, recordings, meeting URL and settings. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/bot/{id}/.

bot_id.description: The bot id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

tools.name: recallai_list_recordings
tools.title: List recordings
tools.description: List recordings, optionally for one bot. A recording holds the media and transcript shortcuts. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/recording/.

bot_id.description: Only recordings made by this bot id.

created_at_after.description: Only items created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

created_at_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 time.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass the cursor from the previous page's next URL.

tools.name: recallai_get_recording
tools.title: Get recording
tools.description: Get one recording: its status, expiry and media_shortcuts (download URLs for video, audio, transcript, participant events). Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/recording/{id}/.

recording_id.description: The recording id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

tools.name: recallai_list_transcripts
tools.title: List transcripts
tools.description: List transcripts, optionally for one recording. Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/transcript/.

recording_id.description: Only transcripts of this recording id.

created_at_after.description: Only items created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

created_at_before.description: Only items created before this ISO 8601 time.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: pass the cursor from the previous page's next URL.

tools.name: recallai_get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Get one transcript: its status, provider and data (the download URL of the transcript JSON). Recall.ai API: GET /api/v1/transcript/{id}/.

transcript_id.description: The transcript id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

tools.name: recallai_create_bot
tools.title: Create bot
tools.description: Send a recording bot to a meeting now, or at join_at. The bot joins and records, and usage is billed by Recall.ai. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/.

meeting_url.description: The full meeting URL (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and others).

bot_name.description: The name shown for the bot in the meeting.

join_at.description: Schedule the join at this ISO 8601 time. Omit to join now.

recording_config.description: Recording settings object, for example the transcript provider. See the Recall.ai bot_create docs.

automatic_leave.description: Automatic leave rules object, as the Recall.ai docs define it.

metadata.description: Your own key/value tags stored with the bot.

tools.name: recallai_send_chat_message
tools.title: Send chat message
tools.description: Post a message in the meeting chat as the bot. Other participants see it. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/{id}/send_chat_message/.

bot_id.description: The bot id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

to.description: Recipient. 'everyone' is the only option on most platforms.

pin.description: Pin the message in the chat.

tools.name: recallai_leave_call
tools.title: Remove bot from call
tools.description: Make the bot leave the meeting now. Recording stops for that bot. Recall.ai API: POST /api/v1/bot/{id}/leave_call/.

bot_id.description: The bot id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

tools.name: recallai_delete_scheduled_bot
tools.title: Delete scheduled bot
tools.description: Delete a scheduled bot that has not joined a call yet. A bot that already joined cannot be deleted this way. Recall.ai API: DELETE /api/v1/bot/{id}/.

bot_id.description: The scheduled bot id (a UUID from Recall.ai).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Recall.ai
prompts.description: What you can do with Recall.ai here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_which_bots_are_in_a_meeting_now
prompts.title: Check which bots are in a meeting now
prompts.description: List the meeting bots in the workspace with their status and meeting URL. Get one bot to see its status changes and recordings.

prompts.name: send_a_bot_to_a_client_call
prompts.title: Send a bot to a client call
prompts.description: Create a recording bot for a meeting now, or for a set join time. Then get the bot to check whether it has joined.

prompts.name: get_the_transcript_of_a_recorded_meeting
prompts.title: Get the transcript of a recorded meeting
prompts.description: List the recordings of a bot, then get one recording with its download links. Get the transcript with its status and download link.

prompts.name: post_a_message_in_a_meeting_chat
prompts.title: Post a message in a meeting chat
prompts.description: Send a chat message as the bot. The other participants in the meeting see it.

prompts.name: remove_a_bot_from_a_call
prompts.title: Remove a bot from a call
prompts.description: Make a bot leave a meeting now. Delete a scheduled bot that has not joined a call yet.
